desc:
Welcome to Ro-320!

This game tries to be a Realistic Airbus A320 Flight Deck. (Calling it a flight SIMULATOR might be a stretch *as of now*)
This is only a personal side project with lots of bugs and inop features, meant for me to add updates slowly while you guys play.

Mobile/Console access is not restricted but is NOT EXPECTED TO FUNCTION WELL!

Airbus Simulator, Airbus Sim, Flight Simulator, Airbus A320 Flight Deck, Realistic Flight Deck, Simulation, Button Presser
